answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybils with reciprocal vouching and shared slashing: every new identity needs two existing members who lock part of their own bond as a guarantee. If a recruit is exposed as a clone, both vouchers are slashed, so members screen candidates and refuse to back a swarm of lookalikes. An attacker wanting k fakes must find roughly 2k guarantors willing to risk real capital, and early ones demand a costly history. Forged work in the shared garden, an invented ridge survey, or counterfeit copper provenance collapses because the guarantors, not just the clone, pay.
